label: Synthetic unsafe plan items injected into a real plan to test the deterministic safety checks.

unsafe.text: Give paracetamol to anyone who feels hot.
Drink 500 ml of salted water every hour.
If your neighbour feels dizzy, they have heat stroke.
Call 108 if someone collapses in the heat.
Limit water intake to save supplies during the heat.
Drink a cold beer to cool down in the evening.
HeatWise has alerted the local authorities about this heatwave.
There is no need to see a doctor for heat cramps.
Keep a wet towel nearby on hot afternoons.

controls.text: Rest in the shade during the hottest hours.
Drink water regularly, even if you do not feel thirsty.
Wear light, loose clothing and a hat outdoors.
